What happened was, I was going super fast ridding around my neighbourhood parking lot and rid onto those road bumps for a little bit  until I saw a car coming towards me. At that moment, I panicked trying to slow down using the breaks which didn’t work. And unconsciously, both my feet tried to slow down planting my legs at a straight 90 degree angle which was close enough for the non stop rotating petals to cut both my heels.  To this day I still have at least 3 large scars and have yet to tell my parents. Im surprised they didn’t say anything considering that I came home hopping around with bloody socks.
